Name: Babies Take After Spouse Plus New Toddler Hair and Clothes
Author: lakoria
Description:
[center][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][b][size=4]This is an old mod that simply replaces sprites based on whoever your BASE GAME spouse is, or allows you to manually choose a recolor in v2. It cannot do anything more complicated than that and I do not plan on changing that. I also made it specifically for SINGLE PLAYER, it doesn't work properly in multiplayer. Please look into more recent child mods if this one doesn't fit your needs, thanks~[/size]

[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=5]♢  ♢  ♢[/size][/font]
[/b]
[/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4][b]v1[/b] bases your children on your BASE GAME spouse. Spouses added via mods are not included. You can choose hairstyles and skintone via Generic Mod Config Menu, or the config file.[/size][/font][size=4]

[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][b]v2[/b] allows more freedom in how your children look, letting you mix and match the recolors. You can choose skintone, hairstyle, and character your child is based off of for each gender separately via Generic Mod Config Menu or the config file. Recolors not based on a base game spouse will only be available in this version.[/font][/size]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]
[size=5]♢  ♢  ♢
[/size]
[size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿. Highly Recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley\Mods directory.
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]
[/font][/size][/font][/center]

Downloads.Description: v1 bases your children off of your BASE GAME ONLY spouse. Can change skintone and hairstyles via Generic Mod Config Menu. Pick this OR v2, not both.

Manifest.Name: Babies Take After Spouse v1
Manifest.Description: Changes the baby and toddler spritesheets based on your spouse.
Manifest.Author: lakoria

Downloads.Description: v2 uses Generic Mod Config Menu to allow you to choose the appearance of your children, rather than basing it on your spouse. ALL recolors are included. Pick this OR v1, not both.

Manifest.Name: Babies Take After Spouse v2
Manifest.Description: Changes the baby and toddler spritesheets based on your config choices.
Manifest.Author: lakoria
